title_short: Angela Harrell · Where Are My Jordans?
headline: Kids at a 4EveryKid giveaway ask for Jordans by name, because a brand-name pair is how a kid facing homelessness gets to blend in.
story: Angela laughs about the tough customers: kids asking where their Jordans are, or if there are any Nikes. In the end everyone leaves happy. Some wear them out the door, some keep the box to show their family.

4EveryKid puts new branded athletic shoes on kids facing homelessness. In the US that is 1.5 million kids. All kids want to be like everyone else: try out for the team, run track, get to school safely.
The button: new shoes let them hold their head up a little higher and blend in, because that's all you want as a kid.
